```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(infer)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(ISLR)
```

```{r}

glimpse(Credit)

```

```{r}

mod.fit <- lm(Income ~ Age, data = Credit)

mod.fit %>%
  broom::tidy()

```

```{r}

Credit %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = Income)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Income", title = "Relationship between Age and Income")

```

```{r}

mod.fit <- lm(Income ~ Education, data = Credit)

mod.fit %>%
  broom::tidy()

```

```{r}

Credit %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Education, y = Income)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Education", y = "Income", title = "Relationship between Years of Education and Income")

```


```{r}

mod.fit <- lm(Income ~ factor(Gender), data = Credit)

mod.fit %>%
  broom::tidy()

```

```{r}

Credit %>% filter(Gender == "Female") %>% summarise(mean_Income_fem = mean(Income, na.rm = TRUE))

Credit %>% filter(Gender == " Male") %>% summarise(mean_Income_male = mean(Income, na.rm = TRUE))

```

```{r}

Credit %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Gender, y = Income, color = Gender)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Gender", y = "Income", title = "Relationship between Gender and Income")

```

mod.fit <- lm(Income ~ factor(Student), data = Credit)

Credit %>% filter(Student == "Yes") %>% summarise(mean_Income_student = mean(Income, na.rm = TRUE))

Credit %>% filter(Ethnicity == "African American") %>% summarise(mean_Income_aa = mean(Income, na.rm = TRUE))

```{r}

mod.fit <- lm(Income ~ Age + Education + factor(Gender) + factor(Student) + factor(Married) + factor(Ethnicity), data = Credit)

mod.fit %>%
  broom::tidy()

```


```{r}

glance(mod.fit) %>%
  select(r.squared, adj.r.squared)

```

```{r}

mod.fit <- lm(Rating ~ Income, data = Credit)

mod.fit %>%
  broom::tidy()

```

```{r}

Credit %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Income, y = Rating, color = Age)) +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Income", y = "Credit Score", title = "Relationship between Credit Score and Income")

```
